A RESOLUTION APPROVING AND SETTING A PROPOSED COUNTY BUDGET FOR THE 2016 FISCAL YEAR

On this day, the 24th day of June 2015, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have met for the purpose of discussing and passing a resolution, setting and approving a proposed County budget for the 2016 fiscal year.

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners believes that it is in the best interests of its citizens to prepare a budget for the upcoming fiscal year; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners is vested with the authority to collect and expend tax revenues in order to provide public services mandated by the Constitution of the State of Georgia and those other needs deemed necessary for the public good; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners acknowledges that a budget is necessary in order to determine a millage rate for ad valorem taxes;

WHEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such resolution was passed unanimously, and the Treutlen

County Board of Commissioners issues the following Resolution:

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners of Treutlen County, Georgia hereby approve and adopt the attached County budget for the 2016 fiscal year; and

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners, shall have the authority to amend any part or portion of said budget, as circumstances may require.

This the 24th day of June, 2015

Chairman of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners

Attest:

County Manager Board of Commissioners
